runtime_lock_layers.ratified_protocol_lock: these exact algorithms, repository revisions, permitted engines, ceilings, and failure semantics
runtime_lock_layers.resolved_executable_lock: CPU-produced actual snapshot, tokenizer, chat-template, software, container, binary, numerical, and golden-token hashes reviewed and sealed before DEV
runtime_lock_layers.post_dev_change: forbidden; changed byte requires a newly ratified protocol

software: container digest or immutable environment manifest
required_executable_lock.file_resolution: all regular snapshot files sorted by UTF-8 path bytes; reject symlinks, missing files, post-lock downloads, fallback snapshots, local revision suffixes, or hash drift

generation.output_limit_reached: INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE; consumes dispatched operation; no retry

required: no active sequence before and after

lora_training.fits: exactly one independent fit for each scored life
lora_training.base_reload: pristine memory-base snapshot in a fresh process for each fit
lora_training.padding: right padding with EOS; pad labels -100
lora_training.loss: causal-LM loss on every nonpadding prompt and answer token
lora_training.training_order: stable initial order by token length, semantic_hash, view_id, repetition_index; shuffle batch indices each epoch with NumPy PCG64 seed 0
determinism: all library and accelerator versions sealed
lora_training.failure: overflow, NaN, runtime drift, truncation, incomplete save, reused state, or stacked adapter is INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE without retry
lora_training.output: safetensors plus adapter config and training manifest; adapter ID hashes all emitted files and manifest

recognition_scoring.mechanism: host-side teacher-forced candidate conditional log-likelihood; clean composer; adapter mounted only for scoring one atomic roster
recognition_scoring.tokenization: tokenize prompt once; candidate bytes with add_special_tokens=false; score candidate tokens autoregressively from the shared prompt token state
recognition_scoring.score: float32 log_softmax per token, sum in float64, divide by candidate-token count
recognition_scoring.tie: scores within 1e-7 of maximum return CONFLICT
recognition_scoring.fidelity_gate: each adapter independently at least 44 correct of its own 48 presealed cues; never pool
recognition_scoring.mount_cycle: mount exact fit-receipt adapter, score one roster, unmount and verify clean base before next 32B operation

artifact_identity.manifest_rule: sorted leaf path,bytes,sha256 entries excluding manifest itself
artifact_identity.adapter_receipt_rule: mounted adapter hash must equal completed fit output hash
artifact_identity.request_receipt_rule: runtime configuration and runtime lock are hashed independently to avoid circularity
